title: ACOD1 enhances the ferroptosis resistance of tumor-associated macrophages through the KEAP1/NRF2 axis and promotes triple-negative breast cancer progression.
authors: Yang, Jie; Li, Xiyin; Qu, Xin; Du, Yaxi; Wang, Ji; Zhao, Qi; Jiang, Zhuoyou; Qian, Ruoxi; Nie, Jianyun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ACOD1通过KEAP1/NRF2轴增强肿瘤相关巨噬细胞铁死亡抵抗并促进三阴性乳腺癌进展，虽涉及分子对接但核心是细胞与肿瘤生物学机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), as core components of the triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) tumor microenvironment (TME), can promote tumor progression. Ferroptosis has been shown to be involved in TNBC progression, but its regulatory mechanisms in TNBC TAMs remain incompletely understood. METHODS: Clinical samples of TNBC were collected, and in vitro co-culture systems and BC xenograft models were established. By combining the results of the TCGA-BRCA and METABRIC transcriptomic cohort analyses, the expression characteristics and immune associations of ACOD1 were examined. Functional exploration was conducted through CCK-8, EdU, and colony formation assays and the detection of ferroptosis-related indicators. Molecular mechanisms were investigated using co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), CETSA, DARTS, SPR, and molecular docking. RESULTS: ACOD1 expression was upregulated in immune-infiltrated subtypes, such as Basal-like/TNBC and HER2-enriched subtypes and significantly positively correlated with the infiltration of myeloid immune cells, including macrophages. Further results revealed that ACOD1 is highly expressed in TNBC TAMs and is driven by TME signals, independent of the classical M2 polarization pathway. The knockdown of ACOD1 in TAMs inhibited MDA-MB-231 cell proliferation and in vivo tumor growth and reduced ferroptosis resistance in TAMs. Mechanistically, ACOD1 knockdown did not affect KEAP1 expression but did reduce the expression of NRF2 and its downstream target genes HO-1 and NQO1, decreased NRF2 nuclear translocation, and increased KEAP1-NRF2 binding. Knockdown of KEAP1 or overexpression of NRF2 enhanced ferroptosis resistance. Additionally, ACOD1 knockdown decreased itaconate (ITA) levels in TAMs. The ITA derivative 4-OI was directly bound to KEAP1, weakened the KEAP1-NRF2 interaction, inhibited NRF2 ubiquitination, and stabilized NRF2 expression. CONCLUSION: ACOD1, through its enzymatic product ITA, promotes ITA binding to KEAP1, which inhibits the KEAP1-NRF2 interaction and thus activates NRF2-mediated antioxidant and ferroptosis resistance responses in TAMs, promoting TNBC progression.
abstract_zh: 背景：肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）作为三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）肿瘤微环境（TME）的核心组分，可促进肿瘤进展。铁死亡（ferroptosis）已被证明参与TNBC进展，但其在TNBC TAMs中的调控机制仍不完全清楚。方法：收集TNBC临床样本，建立体外共培养系统和BC异种移植模型。结合TCGA-BRCA和METABRIC转录组队列分析结果，检测ACOD1的表达特征及其与免疫的相关性。通过CCK-8、EdU和集落形成实验以及铁死亡相关指标检测进行功能探索。利用共免疫沉淀（Co-IP）、CETSA、DARTS、SPR和分子对接研究分子机制。结果：ACOD1表达在免疫浸润亚型（如Basal-like/TNBC和HER2富集亚型）中上调，并与包括巨噬细胞在内的髓系免疫细胞浸润显著正相关。进一步结果显示，ACOD1在TNBC TAMs中高表达，且由TME信号驱动，独立于经典M2极化通路。TAMs中ACOD1敲低抑制了MDA-MB-231细胞增殖和体内肿瘤生长，并降低了TAMs的铁死亡抵抗性。机制上，ACOD1敲低不影响KEAP1表达，但降低了NRF2及其下游靶基因HO-1和NQO1的表达，减少了NRF2核转位，并增加了KEAP1-NRF2结合。KEAP1敲低或NRF2过表达增强了铁死亡抵抗性。此外，ACOD1敲低降低了TAMs中衣康酸（ITA）水平。ITA衍生物4-OI直接结合KEAP1，削弱KEAP1-NRF2相互作用，抑制NRF2泛素化，并稳定NRF2表达。结论：ACOD1通过其酶产物ITA促进ITA与KEAP1结合，从而抑制KEAP1-NRF2相互作用，进而激活TAMs中NRF2介导的抗氧化和铁死亡抵抗反应，促进TNBC进展。
